parsed.rationale_overall: System A demonstrates stronger personalization by tying recommendations to specific user attributes (education goal timeline, loss comfort, two children, tax bracket) and includes a highly actionable 529 plan recommendation with concrete dollar amounts and contribution schedules. System B has slightly tighter factual grounding (e.g., more careful framing of VTI's tech weighting) but lacks the goal-specific actionability and personalization depth of System A.
